summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K reporting that interest on its 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031 payable June 30, 2026 will be paid in shares of Series D Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock. This is a routine interest payment election, not a special situation. No price, premium, or shareholder vote is involved. The filing does not signal an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is an ordinary operational decision with no event-driven risk-arb angle.
